requestStatus.description: Setting this to confirmed emails the customer (once).

date.description: You can change this before confirming, to offer another day.

slot.description: 24-hour Indian time, for example 14:30. You can change it before confirming.

language.description: The language of the customer's emails.

meetingLink.description: Fill in BEFORE confirming: it goes in the email and on the confirmation page.

messageToCustomer.description: Optional note for the customer. Fill in BEFORE confirming.

confirmationEmailSentAt.description: Clear this and save to send the confirmation email again.

paymentStatus.description: Empty on older requests made before payments existed. For UPI: check your bank app, then set this to paid. The customer is emailed once.

amountMinor.description: Fee in paise/cents, fixed when the booking was made.

paidEmailSentAt.description: Clear this and save to send the payment-received email again.

token.description: Do not change. It is part of the customer's link.
